rendered.text: ← Back to home REAL-TIME CODING DUELS AlgoWars brings the thrill of competitive gaming to programming. Challenge developers worldwide in real-time 1v1 coding duels where speed, accuracy, and algorithmic thinking determine the winner. How Coding Duels Work Both players receive the same algorithmic problem simultaneously. You race against your opponent to write and submit a correct solution. The first player to get an accepted submission wins the duel and gains Elo rating points. Game Modes Blitz (15 min) — Fast-paced, high-pressure duels Classical (20 min) — More time for complex problems Private Duel — Challenge a specific friend via invite link Against Time — Solo mode, beat the clock Why Coding Duels? Traditional competitive programming platforms let you solve problems at your own pace. AlgoWars adds a human opponent and a live timer — simulating the pressure of coding interviews and real contests. Every duel improves your speed, problem-solving, and ability to code under pressure. START YOUR FIRST DUEL →
